item.title: New Research Explores Temporal Preferences in Robot Learning from Human Corrections
item.description:
New Research Explores Temporal Preferences in Robot Learning from Human Corrections

A paper submitted to arXiv on November 23, 2026, introduces a novel approach to learning from human corrections in robotics by leveraging both when and how humans choose to intervene.

#Robotics #HumanRobotInteraction #LearningFromCorrections #PreferenceLearning #ValueAlignment #ICRA2027

Source: Learning from Human Corrections through Temporal Preferences Source: Hi3R-VLA: Grounding Semantics and Actions in 3D Source: FoveaWAM: Role-Aware 4D World-Action Modeling for Dynamic Manipulation Source: Sparks of Weight-Space Programming for Robot Foundation Models Source: Many Senses, One World: Learning Hierarchical Multimodal World Representations for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation Source: PreWAM: Exploring the Design of Latent Future Prediction for World-Action Modeling Source: RoboHarness-RL: Agentic Reinforcement Learning for VLM-Based Robot Manipulation Source: KeyMemVLA: Subtask-Guided Key Memory for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
